# Work Packages: Vikunja Docker Deploy

**Inputs**: Design documents from `kitty-specs/001-vikunja-docker-deploy/`
**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (user stories), research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md

**Tests**: Manual verification against acceptance scenarios. No automated test suite.

**Organization**: Fine-grained subtasks (`Txxx`) roll up into work packages (`WPxx`). Each work package must be independently deliverable and testable.

**Prompt Files**: Each work package references a matching prompt file in `tasks/` generated by `/spec-kitty.tasks`.

---

## Work Package WP01: Docker Deploy and systemd Service (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Get Vikunja running in Docker on office2, bound to Tailscale IP, managed by systemd, with SQLite data persisted to `/data/services/vikunja/data/`.
**Independent Test**: `curl http://100.92.197.90:3456` from office2 returns the Vikunja web UI. `systemctl status vikunja` shows active.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP01-docker-deploy-systemd.md`
**Requirement Refs**: FR-001, NFR-001, C-001, C-003, C-004, C-005, C-006, C-007

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T001 Discover office2 environment (Docker version, Docker Compose presence, existing systemd patterns)
- [ ] T002 Select and pin Vikunja Docker image version
- [ ] T003 Create data directory at `/data/services/vikunja/data/`
- [ ] T004 Create `scripts/vikunja/vikunja.service` systemd unit file
- [ ] T005 Create `scripts/vikunja/deploy.sh` deployment script
- [ ] T006 Deploy container on office2 bound to `100.92.197.90:3456`
- [ ] T007 Install and enable systemd unit (requires sudo — present to Kent)

### Implementation Notes
- SSH to office2 as claude user: `ssh office2-claude`
- Check Docker: `docker --version`, `docker compose version`
- Check existing systemd pattern: `cat /etc/systemd/system/obsidian-sync.service`
- Pin image version from Docker Hub (not `latest`)
- Bind to `100.92.197.90:3456:3456` — never `0.0.0.0`
- systemd unit installation requires sudo — present the exact commands to Kent

### Parallel Opportunities
- T004 (systemd unit) and T005 (deploy script) can be written in parallel

### Dependencies
- None (starting package)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Docker not installed → T001 checks and fails with clear message
- Port 3456 already in use → deploy.sh checks with `ss -tlnp | grep 3456`
- Tailscale IP changes → document in runbook; bind IP is in one place (deploy.sh)

---

## Work Package WP02: Automated Setup Script (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Create an idempotent Python script that configures Vikunja with the correct project hierarchy, identity labels, and saved filters via the REST API.
**Independent Test**: Run `setup_vikunja.py` once — all entities created. Run again — no duplicates, no errors.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP02-setup-script.md`
**Requirement Refs**: FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-007, NFR-003

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T008 Create `scripts/vikunja/setup_vikunja.py` with argument parsing and interactive auth
- [ ] T009 Implement JWT authentication via `POST /api/v1/login`
- [ ] T010 Implement idempotent project hierarchy creation (Everyday/Inbox/Someday, five Areas, CT-90day)
- [ ] T011 Implement idempotent label creation (`personal`, `intentional`)
- [ ] T012 Verify saved filter syntax against pinned Vikunja version API docs
- [ ] T013 Implement idempotent saved filter creation (Today, Upcoming, Overdue)
- [ ] T014 Add readiness check (wait for Vikunja API to respond before proceeding)

### Implementation Notes
- Script prompts for username/password, obtains JWT via `/api/v1/login`, does not persist token
- Idempotency: check-before-create for all entities (match by name/title)
- Projects: use `GET /api/v1/projects` to list existing, `POST /api/v1/projects` to create
- Labels: use `GET /api/v1/labels` to list existing, `PUT /api/v1/labels` to create
- Filters: use `GET /api/v1/filters` to list existing, `POST /api/v1/filters` to create
- Readiness check: retry `GET /api/v1/info` with exponential backoff, timeout after 30 seconds
- Filter syntax must be verified against the pinned version (T012) before implementing T013

### Parallel Opportunities
- T010 (projects), T011 (labels) can be developed in parallel after T008/T009 are complete

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (Vikunja must be running to test the script)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Filter syntax differs from expected → T012 verifies before implementation
- API not ready when script runs → T014 adds readiness check with timeout
- Parent project IDs needed for subprojects → create parents first, capture IDs

## Work Package WP03: Ops Runbook and Security Baseline (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Create the operations runbook at `docs/handbooks/vikunja-ops.md` and document the security baseline reset procedure.
**Independent Test**: Runbook passes `validate_docs.py`. A new agent session can follow the runbook to perform basic operations.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP03-ops-runbook.md`
**Requirement Refs**: FR-006, C-002

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T015 Create `docs/handbooks/vikunja-ops.md` with frontmatter
- [ ] T016 Document start/stop/restart procedures
- [ ] T017 Document SQLite database location and backup verification
- [ ] T018 Document version update procedure (pin new version, redeploy)
- [ ] T019 Document Tailscale access and troubleshooting
- [ ] T020 Document security baseline reset at `/data/services/security-monitor/baselines/`

### Implementation Notes
- Runbook must have valid YAML frontmatter (title, doc_type: handbook, status: draft)
- Reference actual paths: `/data/services/vikunja/data/`, systemd unit name
- Security baseline reset may require sudo — document as a manual step for Kent
- Include `restic snapshots` command for backup verification

### Parallel Opportunities
- All subtasks can be written in parallel (independent sections of the same document)
- WP03 can proceed in parallel with WP02 after WP01 is complete

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (needs actual service name, paths, and commands)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Runbook references paths that don't exist yet → write after WP01 deployment confirms actual paths

---

## Work Package WP04: Verification and Acceptance (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Verify all acceptance scenarios from the spec, confirm security posture, and validate backup inclusion.
**Independent Test**: All acceptance scenarios pass. Port not reachable outside Tailscale. Data survives container replacement.
**Prompt**: `tasks/WP04-verification-acceptance.md`
**Requirement Refs**: FR-002, NFR-002, NFR-004, C-001, C-007

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T021 Verify web UI accessible from Mac via Tailscale
- [ ] T022 Verify web UI accessible from iPhone via Tailscale
- [ ] T023 Verify port binding — `ss -tlnp | grep 3456` shows `100.92.197.90` only
- [ ] T024 Verify systemd restart — `systemctl restart vikunja` recovers within 30 seconds
- [ ] T025 Verify data persistence — stop container, start new one, confirm tasks preserved
- [ ] T026 Verify backup — check `restic snapshots` includes `/data/services/vikunja/data/`
- [ ] T027 Verify setup script idempotency — run twice, confirm no duplicates

### Implementation Notes
- Run all checks via `ssh office2-claude`
- iPhone verification requires Kent to confirm manually
- Backup verification may need to wait for the 4AM run or trigger a manual backup
- Document results as pass/fail for each acceptance scenario

### Parallel Opportunities
- T021-T023 can run in parallel (independent checks)
- T024-T027 are sequential (each modifies or depends on system state)

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01, WP02, WP03 (all must be complete before acceptance)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Backup not yet run → trigger manual backup or wait for 4AM
- iPhone not on Tailscale → Kent must verify manually

---

## Dependency & Execution Summary

- **Sequence**: WP01 → WP02 + WP03 (parallel) → WP04
- **Parallelization**: WP02 and WP03 can proceed simultaneously after WP01 completes
- **MVP Scope**: WP01 + WP02 constitute the minimal viable deployment (running Vikunja with correct project structure)
